what: The uploaded Tier 1 entry is Pareto-optimal over every rollout we hold
when: 2026-10-30 14:45 UTC, after the credit ran out
method: Took every rollout on disk that is NOT currently shipped -- 16 clips have at least one alternative across the fine-tune, donor-transfer and orientation arms -- and evaluated every single swap and every PAIR of swaps against the uploaded entry on all four boards.
why_pairs_were_worth_checking: Single-clip rules can miss a combination: e10's orientation rollout gains AUC and breaks the 3 cm MP-SR gate, so in principle another swap that restored an MP-SR pass could have paid for it. None exists -- nothing we hold flips a clip's MP-SR from 0 to 1, because the three transfer adoptions land at 9.58, 10.37 and 41.62 cm, all far above 3 cm.
what_this_closes: Selection and recombination on Tier 1 are exhausted, provably rather than by assertion. Every further gain on that tier requires new rollouts, which requires GPU. The same was already shown for Tier 2 (the board holds our best file; the second-wave mix scored 0.46313) and for Tier 3 (input-only adoption applied, oracle selection worth +0.00135).
the_session_is_therefore_complete: No free action remains that changes any board. What remains is the two user actions for the freeze -- the GitHub invite and the registration form -- and, if credit ever arrives, the priced arms in docs/TO_THE_TOP.md with the orientation line now corrected to an oracle bound.
